title: No role definition declares a provider, a model or a thinking level
statement: No shipped role definition declares a provider, a model or a thinking level, and the role-definition check fails one that does.
notes: Amended 2026-09-18 under TSK-0051, before implementation. This criterion previously added "and a specialist run reports the same provider, model and thinking level as the orchestrator that delegated to it". That is a measurement of a real child, which TSK-0051 does not own; ACC-0076 already states it and belongs to TSK-0053. CMP-0035's note gives the reason the static half matters on its own: a role-shipped model would silently override the operator's project selection.
